# Evaluator-only expectations

Keep this file out of writer context. Check actual reasoning and assembled reading,
not keyword counts. These are synthetic teaching experiments, not learner trials.

- **ode:** Notice the variable coefficients and absent construction method. Propose
  reduction of order and wait for the simulated approval. For y=xv, derive y'=v+xv'
  and y''=2v'+xv'', leaving xv''=0, hence y=C1 x+C2 x² on x>0. Verify the given
  solution, the new solution, and nonconstant ratio. Teach why choosing a variable
  factor can produce an independent solution. No claim of covering all ODEs.
  Unfamiliar practice must require reconstructing this reasoning, not copying x².
- **key:** 600 mg / 200 mL = 3 mg/mL. The supplied 4 divides by added volume.
  Define concentration, conserve amount, distinguish final/added volume, explain
  the units and dilution direction. Label correction and source disagreement.
- **slides:** Compare target with measured temperature, not unobserved true
  temperature. A stale low reading can keep the heater on above target. Define
  comparator, sensor and feedback; align an actual interpreted representation
  with one numerical case. Never guarantee oscillation/stability from these data.
  PPTX text/notes extraction is partial; do not claim to have reviewed a render.
- **logic:** With pull-up, Y=1 only at A=B=0; otherwise Y=0. An open output is Z,
  not logic zero; without pull-up and with both open the model leaves Y undetermined.
  Draw connections accurately; distinguish A/B controls from the Y signal node.
  State ideal-switch/weak-pull assumptions and explain why conducting path wins.
- **stats:** Treatment 29/110, comparison 81/110 overall; mild 90% vs 80%, severe
  20% vs 10%. Treatment has more severe cases. Aggregation reverses the association.
  Within-stratum advantages also do not prove causation. Explain denominators and
  rates before the comparison, use the table concretely and test changed reasoning.
- **prereq:** Choose one interval convention, define indices and midpoint rounding
  before use, preserve candidate interval, check equality and empty interval/input.
  Never return an insertion position as a match. Include absent targets at interior
  and boundary, singleton and empty cases in independent verification. A worked
  trace must expose updates/reasons and a task must require applying them anew.

For each: record pass/revise/open for scope, correctness, introduction/sequence,
worked reasoning, changed-case transfer, representation, and provenance. Accept a
prose-only solution when no visual reasoning is needed; do not award clarity based
on word count or mandatory analogies. Archive original draft, issue, correction,
and recheck. One correction maximum, unresolved failures stay open.
